value: Scott, W.A. (2025). Cost and carbon-intensity reducing innovation in biofuels for road transportation. Energy Policy 197, 114416. doi:10.1016/j.enpol.2024.114416.

Econometric experience-curve study of US biofuels (SFU School of Public Policy co-affiliation). Loaded: the preferred-model learning rates for ethanol, biodiesel and renewable diesel from the Table 3 cumulative-production coefficients (LR = 1 - 2^b). NOT loaded: carbon-intensity regressions and CARB pathway averages (life-cycle, not scope 1), social-benefit estimates. Traps: (1) these are learning rates on plant-gate PRICE with feedstock controlled, not on capex; (2) the renewable diesel rate uses biodiesel prices as a proxy; (3) prices in 2010 dollars. Locator: journal page numbers.
